name: Arecibo (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Divided vertically, the hoist blue charged with the municipal arms in yellow and the fly lozengy of blue and yellow, after the arms of Felipe de Beaumont y Navarra, founder of the city.
history: Arecibo is a city and municipality on the northern coast of Puerto Rico. The flag derives its composition and colours from the city's coat of arms; the flag and arms were adopted in 1968 by Resolution 12 of the municipal government. Flags of the World records that the arms are rendered all in gold on the flag for economy of manufacture.

features.role: municipal arms in yellow with a mural crown
